articles.title: Bill Gates: « I will always choose a lazy person to do a difficult job »
articles.standfirst: The well-known quote holds that he would choose a lazy person to tackle a difficult job because they would find an easy way to solve it.
articles.summary: The well-known quote holds that he would choose a lazy person to tackle a difficult job because they would find an easy way to solve it.
articles.body:
"The phrase has become one of the best-known reflections on productivity, effort, and ingenuity attributed to Bill Gates . The full version adds that this lazy person will find a simple way to do it.

The idea starts from a paradox: whoever receives a complicated task may devote many hours to the usual procedure, while whoever tries to reduce the effort looks from the outset for an alternative to reach the same result.

Technology and automation

This phrase has become one of the best-known reflections on productivity, effort, and ingenuity. It does not necessarily mean working worse, but rather asking whether there is a different way to do what one has been tasked with.

The theory is based on the idea that a person who seeks to avoid unnecessary work may be forced to think in a different way and find a much more efficient procedure

Automating processes, eliminating unnecessary steps, or designing tools that solve a task in seconds are common strategies in technology companies. The key, he indicates, lies in achieving the objective with resources in a smarter way.

Gates built much of his career around technology and the creation of tools to make tasks easier. Microsoft, founded by him and Paul Allen in 1975 , turned software into a tool that became increasingly present in homes, businesses, and educational centers. One of the major changes in computing was automating tasks that previously required a great deal of manual work, and today this is growing even more with Copilot AI. From spreadsheets to word processors, many digital tools were created with a very specific purpose: to make simpler what previously required more time and effort.

The trail of the expression goes further back. Clarence E. Bleicher, then president of Chrysler's DeSoto division, testified on January 31, 1947, before the U.S. Senate Committee on Labor and Public Welfare.

' Bleicher said that, when faced with a difficult job for which there was no simple method, he would put a lazy man in charge , because within ten days he would have an easy way to do it. To Senator Ellender, who asked him why he would choose a lazy man rather than a hardworking one, he replied that "the lazy man will find an easy way to do it."'

The wording recorded in that intervention does not literally match the quote that circulates under Gates's name. It does, however, share the central idea: assigning a complicated task to someone who will seek to reduce the effort needed to solve it.

articles.title: Eva Longoria cleans her pool in a floor-length gown and somehow makes housework glamorous
articles.summary: Eva Longoria is finally doing housework, but apparently she only does it when she looks ready for the red carpet.
articles.body:
Eva Longoria is finally doing housework, but apparently she only does it when she looks ready for the red carpet.

The 51-year-old actress shared a playful video of herself cleaning a swimming pool while wearing an elegant, floor-length white gown. With the Los Angeles skyline behind her, Longoria carefully worked around the water without sacrificing an ounce of glamour.

“20 years later and I’m finally doing housework,” she joked in the caption, instantly reminding fans of Gabrielle Solis, her famously glamorous character from “Desperate Housewives.” Two decades later, Longoria proved that even pool maintenance can become a fashion moment when you choose the right outfit.

articles.title: Lewis Hamilton shows Kim Kardashian their quiet side in photos filled with extravagant dates
articles.standfirst: An outdoor movie theater and a cruise past the Eiffel Tower drew attention, but their London bike ride may be the most revealing moment in his latest post
articles.summary: An outdoor movie theater and a cruise past the Eiffel Tower drew attention, but their London bike ride may be the most revealing moment in his latest post
articles.body:
Lewis Hamilton could have led with the champagne cruise. Instead, the first image in his September 22 Instagram carousel shows him taking a selfie with Kim Kardashian during a bike ride. His caption is just as casual: “Bit of this, bit of that.”

The rest of the post moves between very different kinds of dates. There is an outdoor movie setup with a large screen, rattan trays and a cart stocked with desserts. In Paris, champagne sits aboard a boat on the Seine with the Eiffel Tower in view ; later, Hamilton films the landmark sparkling after dark. He did not identify where the movie night took place.

The bike ride tells another part of the story

Hamilton and Kardashian rode Lime bikes with friends in London on September 18, while Kardashian was in the city for the opening of a Skims store on Regent Street. Two people whose lives usually unfold around cameras, premieres and international travel spent part of the day doing something almost ordinary. That contrast makes the selfie stand out among the more elaborate images.

Their next public appearance was far more formal. On September 19, both attended the opening-night celebration of the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles. Hamilton’s carousel ends with a photograph from inside the museum, quietly connecting another shared evening to the dates he chose to show his followers.

The couple confirmed their relationship on Instagram in April, after dating reports began earlier in the year. Since then, they have shared glimpses of trips together, including time with family. The new carousel does not announce another milestone or explain where the relationship is headed.

What it does show is how Hamilton chose to tell this part of their story : a bike ride first, then the movie screen, Paris at sunset and a night out in Los Angeles. The grand gestures are there, but the image he used to open the post is simply the two of them together on a bike.

articles.title: Lindsey Vonn confirms her relationship with French skier Matthieu Bailet, 11 years younger
articles.standfirst: The American Olympic champion made the relationship public through a series of photographs from their vacation. Bailet, 30, and Vonn, 41, had been seen together in New York in May.
articles.summary: The American Olympic champion made the relationship public through a series of photographs from their vacation. Bailet, 30, and Vonn, 41, had been seen together in New York in May.
articles.body:
"L indsey Vonn , the 41-year-old American, posted several photos on Instagram from her summer vacation in which she appears alongside the 30-year-old athlete, putting an end to the rumors that had arisen months earlier.

Vonn accompanied the images with the message "It's about time to do a summer recap… part 1❤️". Bailet responded to the post with an "I can't wait to see the second part of the summer recap😉😘". Among the photographs, the two appear together in a swimming pool, in the sea, and during different moments of their vacation.

A relationship that had already generated rumors

The relationship had begun to be publicly discussed in May, when Vonn and Bailet were seen together in New York. Both were photographed while shopping in the SoHo neighborhood, riding the subway, and posing together backstage at the Broadway musical The Outsiders. A source cited at the time explained that they were “getting to know each other better”.

Those appearances took place during Vonn's visit to New York for the Met Gala . The American had also left a comment on one of Bailet's Instagram posts, fueling speculation about a possible relationship between the two alpine skiing specialists.

Bailet, born in Nice, is a French skier specializing in speed events. He made his World Cup debut in March 2016 , in St. Moritz, and competed in the Beijing 2022 Olympic Games. In March 2026, he also competed in the World Cup finals in Kvitfjell, Norway.

For Vonn, this is her first known relationship since her breakup with Diego Osorio . The skier confirmed in February 2025 the end of her several-year relationship with the businessman. “This year, Valentine’s Day will be a little different for me. But I have my two dogs, so they will be my companions for the day.”, she explained at the time.

Vonn, also focused on her recovery

The announcement comes months after Vonn's return to the 2026 Winter Olympics . The American suffered a serious crash during the downhill event in Cortina d"Ampezzo and had to undergo several surgical procedures. Her recovery has shaped much of her activity over the past few months.

"In May, Vonn explained that she hoped to take advantage of the summer to disconnect after the months following the injury. “I want to have a great summer and I need to disconnect a little from everything”, said the Olympic champion, who at the time was getting around with crutches and a cane.

The September post shows that Bailet was part of that summer. Although the couple had already been publicly linked during the spring, the photographs shared by Vonn constitute the first direct confirmation of the relationship by the skier. Bailet also shared the post on his Instagram stories.

articles.title: The drama surrounding Sydney Sweeney's advert gets an epic response: “The world will keep turning”
articles.standfirst: Charley Hull dismissed the idea that every image needs a deeper meaning
articles.summary: Charley Hull dismissed the idea that every image needs a deeper meaning
articles.body:
Charley Hull has stepped into the debate surrounding Sydney Sweeney ’s controversial Novig campaign with a characteristically blunt message being, people are overthinking it.

The golf star weighed in after a wave of criticism from female athletes who argued that Sweeney’s sports-themed advert sexualized women and distracted from the athleticism of women’s sport. Hull sees it differently.

“My opinion on the @sydney_sweeney advert? People are genuinely getting pissed off because an actress/model is… modelling in an advert. ???? That is quite literally her job,” Hull wrote on Instagram.

“Not everything needs a 45-minute psychological breakdown and a public inquiry,” Hull added. “Sometimes a pretty woman in an advert is just a pretty woman in an advert. The world will keep spinning, I promise. ????"

Issue goes beyond Sweeney herself

The Novig campaign features Sweeney posing with sports equipment while promoting the company’s “Just Sports” branding.

That imagery drew criticism from a number of prominent female athletes, who said the campaign blurred the line between promoting sport and sexualizing women connected to it.

World champion boxer Skye Nicolson was among those to respond, writing: “Respectfully Sydney Sweeney, This is sport… Stop sexualizing women in sport.”

Other athletes, including Ariarne Titmus, Amy Hunt, Sophie Capewell, Lisa Neumann, Ellie Boatman and Tilly Kearns , also joined the broader backlash.

One athlete wrote: “How do we live in a world where monetizing a woman’s body and sexualizing women’s sport is still a thing?”

Another argued that young girls need to understand that “attention and value are not the same thing,” warning that appearance can bring likes, money and opportunities without necessarily reflecting achievement.

Novig pushes back on criticism

Novig co-founder Jacob Fortinsky has defended the campaign and said the company was not trying to depict women’s sport.

“As a company, we’re hugely supportive of women’s sports,” Fortinsky said. “We never intended to portray female sports.”

He also stressed that Sweeney was appearing in her role as an actress.

“Sydney’s an actress,” Fortinsky added. “We’re a prediction market that is focused on sports, and that was the story she was communicating.”

Sweeney , who is also a strategic partner and equity holder in Novig, has not directly addressed the criticism.

She appeared to respond indirectly by sharing images from ESPN’s former “Body Issue” shoots featuring professional athletes.

Hull ’s intervention adds another prominent voice to the dispute, but from the opposite side.

Critics see the campaign as part of a broader pattern in which women’s sport is reduced to image and sexuality.

Hull ’s view is that an actress posed for an advert, and not every campaign needs to become a referendum on women’s sport.

articles.title: The billionaire YouTuber MrBeast claims that he spent $10 million building a village in Ghana.
articles.standfirst: The project replaces a school without doors or windows that was attended by more than 300 children. It also includes drainage, solar panels, and a community farm.
articles.summary: The project replaces a school without doors or windows that was attended by more than 300 children. It also includes drainage, solar panels, and a community farm.
articles.body:
Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, posted a video this weekend showing how a village was built in Ghana . According to him, the investment was 10 million dollars.

The village is called Abna Dakwa and the construction work lasted eight months. Donaldson explained that the goal is to keep children and families out of illegal labor. He also wrote that his 14-year career on YouTube had been the path to this project.

Houses, school, and drainage for an already existing village

A school without doors or windows is replaced by a new one. Before the construction, more than 300 children attended a school without windows or doors and with a dirt floor. When it rained, the building flooded and the students stopped going. Many have to walk several kilometers to get there, in surroundings that the video shows as dirty and with sweltering heat.

To curb flooding, the team built drains that also prevent water from blocking access to the village. The residents requested a community center, a farm, and a water well. All three were built, along with a market, sanitation facilities, and homes. Solar panels were also installed to generate electricity.

The school will provide free meals to students for five years, with the intention that the children and their families remain in the education system. The children themselves designed their playground.

The project adds a soccer field . As stated in the video, the idea is that the next Messi or the next Ronaldo could come from there.

Homes with solar panels and running water

The other focus of the project is the villagers' homes. According to the video, the houses were built with running water, a service they had not had until now . Consumption was one of the most problematic issues in the village, where its inhabitants were becoming ill on a large scale due to the lack of drinking water.

Solar panels were also installed to generate electricity for the village. That supply is added to the drainage system and the well, which complete the settlement’s basic infrastructure works.

Before premiering the video, Donaldson warned on X that the content would not have a broad reach. "It probably won't do very well, but it's something I care deeply about and I hope my passion shows", he wrote. One follower even pointed out in a comment that his humanitarian videos usually get fewer views than the rest.

'The YouTuber responded: "It’s funny when they say I only help people for the views, because it’s exactly the opposite. It doesn’t matter, helping people gives me purpose and, even if no one sees it, I’ll keep doing it."'

Another user asked him why he wasn't doing more for Greenville , in North Carolina, where he grew up and where his company is headquartered. Donaldson replied: "If I listed everything we do locally, it wouldn't fit in this tweet".

The project is part of the goals of Beast Philanthropy, Donaldson's nonprofit organization . These include eradicating child labor in Ghana, bringing clean drinking water to millions of people, delivering more than 48 million meals, and planting more than 25 million trees.

articles.title: Megan Fox Is Skeptical of the Relationship Between MGK and Dakota Johnson: “She’s Not Sure He’s Mature Enough”
articles.standfirst: The actress reportedly has serious doubts about her ex-partner’s ability to maintain a healthy relationship with the star of *Fifty Shades of Grey*.
articles.summary: The actress reportedly has serious doubts about her ex-partner’s ability to maintain a healthy relationship with the star of *Fifty Shades of Grey*.
articles.body:
According to reports, Megan Fox has expressed doubts about the alleged romance between Dakota Johnson and her ex-fiancé, the musician MGK, formerly known as Machine Gun Kelly.

The report comes after several weeks of rumors surrounding MGK and Johnson. The two were seen together in New York in early September and ran into each other again in Milan during Fashion Week. Neither of them has publicly confirmed that they are in a romantic relationship.

“Megan is concerned about what Dakota is getting herself into”

The “Transformers” star reportedly has “serious doubts” about whether MGK is mature enough to start a relationship with Dakota Johnson. That said, the actress hopes things work out between them, but her own experiences with the musician make her cautious.

Fox and MGK currently have a good relationship as parents to Saga, and she still cares about her ex-partner’s happiness. Although she wishes him the best , the actress would not want to go through the complicated dynamic she experienced during her relationship with the singer again.

The source also points out a difference between Dakota Johnson and MGK. Fox has reportedly heard good things about the actress and would have no problem with her being part of the musician’s inner circle. Her concern centers on Baker and his ability to maintain a stable relationship.

Megan Fox's Look That Sparked Comments on Social Media

Megan Fox set social media ablaze on August 14 with a series of photos in which she wore a tiny black latex top under an oversized green coat. The actress paired the outfit with black pants, fur boots, sunglasses, and a choker necklace. The post included the message “intellectual compatibility.”

The post was made in August, before MGK and Dakota Johnson’s public appearances began to spark new speculation.

MGK and Dakota Johnson Cross Paths in Milan

Dakota Johnson’s name was all over the news alongside MGK during Milan Fashion Week. The actress sat in the front row at the Vogue World 2026 fashion show, where the musician walked the runway as a model. Baker walked the runway in a neon orange jumpsuit by Byblos and black sneakers, while Johnson attended in a black dress and a mesh midi skirt.

Johnson’s appearance came after the two were photographed in New York getting out of a black SUV. The photos were apparently taken about a week before the fashion show and fueled rumors of a possible romance. However, there has been no public confirmation of a relationship between the two.

A Reaction from MGK That Fueled Speculation

On September 23, MGK was approached by fans while posing for photos in Milan. At that moment, someone mentioned Dakota Johnson, and the musician’s expression changed. The reaction was interpreted as another piece of the speculation, but on its own, it does not confirm a relationship.

Meanwhile, Fox and MGK’s current situations remain linked by their romantic history and by the rumors surrounding the musician. Fox and Baker were engaged, but the current situation involving MGK and Johnson remains unconfirmed. For now, the only concrete details are their public appearances in New York and Milan and the rapper’s reaction to a mention of the actress during an encounter with fans.

articles.title: Dick Van Dyke, 100-year-old actor: "Let the outside sag and wrinkle; change what’s on the inside"
articles.standfirst: He rejects the obsession with looking young and focuses instead on character, curiosity and perspective
articles.summary: He rejects the obsession with looking young and focuses instead on character, curiosity and perspective
articles.body:
At 100, Dick Van Dyke has reached an age few people ever experience, and one of his most memorable observations on growing older rejects the instinct to fight every visible sign of time.

“Let the outside sag and wrinkle; change what’s on the inside,” the actor is quoted as saying. The line works because it separates two things that are often treated as inseparable, physical aging and personal growth.

Wrinkles, gray hair and changes in appearance are part of getting older. Van Dyke ’s point is that those changes do not have to define the person underneath them.

The body changes whether someone wants it to or not. Character, curiosity and attitude remain much more open to choice.

Less about appearance than control

Van Dyke ’s remark can sound lighthearted at first, but its deeper point is about deciding what deserves attention. Trying to stop every outward sign of aging can become an endless battle against something that cannot ultimately be avoided.

Changing what is “on the inside,” by contrast, remains possible at any age. That might mean becoming more patient, learning something new, repairing a relationship or reconsidering an old assumption. None of those things require youth.

The quote also challenges the idea that growing older automatically means becoming less adaptable. Physical limitations may increase, but that does not require someone to become emotionally rigid or intellectually closed off.

A person can continue changing long after their appearance begins showing the years.

Aging doesn't have to mean becoming fixed

That's what gives the quote much of its lasting appeal. Modern culture often treats youth as something that must be preserved at almost any cost.

Van Dyke ’s message moves in the opposite direction, to accept the visible changes and concentrate instead on becoming a better version of yourself. That doesn't mean ignoring health or pretending aging is easy.

It means understanding that self-worth doesn't have to be tied entirely to appearance. Someone can look older and still become more curious. They can move more slowly and still become more generous. They can lose some physical ability while gaining perspective.

Appearance can be managed only so much. Internal growth has no obvious age limit. That makes Van Dyke ’s line about more than wrinkles.

It's about accepting what cannot be controlled while continuing to work on what can and to stop treating age as the most important thing about you.

articles.title: "No one thinks self-regulation is enough": Bill Gates sees AI doing things on its own and warns humanity could lose control
articles.standfirst: Microsoft co-founder and billionaire Bill Gates urged lawmakers in Washington to regulate the development of AI
articles.summary: Microsoft co-founder and billionaire Bill Gates urged lawmakers in Washington to regulate the development of AI
articles.body:
The artificial intelligence industry is facing an unusual moment of agreement. After years of companies racing to build increasingly powerful models, several of the sector’s biggest leaders have recently backed the idea of slowing the pace of AI development and putting stronger AI safety measures in place.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for a more deliberate approach, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman , Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis and xAI’s Elon Musk also expressed support for greater AI oversight and independent safety evaluations.

The concern is no longer limited to outsiders: some of the people building the technology are openly questioning how quickly it should advance.

Bill Gates Wants Washington to Regulate AI

Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has now added his voice to the debate, arguing that AI companies cannot rely on self regulation alone. In an interview with NBC News’ Meet the Press, Gates said lawmakers and law enforcement need to become directly involved in deciding what AI safeguards and monitoring should be required.

He acknowledged that regulation would create some additional burden for AI companies, but argued that it would not necessarily bring AI innovation to a halt. Gates has outlined several areas where he believes the risks could become especially serious.

AI could deliver major advances in medicine, agriculture and scientific research , but increasingly capable systems could also be used for cybercrime, fraud and biological attacks .

He has also warned about a major disruption to the labor market , particularly as AI becomes capable of performing increasingly sophisticated white-collar work and, eventually, more physical tasks through advanced robotics.

In a recent essay, Gates went even further, proposing that governments consider taxing AI systems or robots that replace human workers in a way similar to payroll taxes.

He has also raised the possibility of reserving certain jobs for humans , arguing that society needs a plan for the transition rather than simply allowing automation to move forward without safeguards. His broader concern is that the economic and social disruption caused by AI could arrive much faster than previous technological shifts.

The prospect of self improving superintelligence has become one of the most debated issues in the AI industry, particularly as companies race to develop more powerful models.

That is why Gates believes governments cannot afford to remain on the sidelines . He has called for national and international plans that would establish safeguards while still allowing useful AI research to continue.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney returns to lingerie with “Send Nudes” after Novig controversy
articles.standfirst: The actress unveiled Syrn’s new campaign.
articles.summary: The actress unveiled Syrn’s new campaign.
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney is back in lingerie, and the name of her new campaign already says quite a lot. “Send Nudes” is the latest proposal from Syrn, the lingerie brand founded by the actress, which shared its first images four days ago.

The concept plays on a familiar phrase from the internet and the word nude , but it also sets the tone for the collection: nude shades, delicate designs and a color palette brought directly into lingerie.

Sydney’s look has one detail that stands out

In the images shared by Syrn on Instagram, Sydney wears a nude-toned bra, finished with a delicate lace detail and a small bow at the center .

The design keeps a simple silhouette while letting the color become an important part of the concept. It is not simply another lingerie piece, but a collection built around the same idea introduced by its name.

And for Sydney, this is not the first time she has used her own image to introduce a new Syrn collection.

From “Birthday Boobs” to “Send Nudes”

The new campaign comes after another launch that was also directly tied to the actress.

Sydney turned 29 on September 12, and Syrn began preparing for the celebration in August with “Birthday Boobs,” a collection officially released on September 1 that leaned into lace and bolder designs to give the occasion a much sexier twist.

But there’s one detail that makes the timing more notable

The new campaign arrived just days after Sydney once again found herself at the center of a much more controversial conversation.

The actress starred in a campaign for Novig , the betting company she co-owns and holds a stake in, in which she appeared nude and covered only by sports balls from different disciplines.

The ad drew criticism over the way it presented the female body within a sports setting. Several female athletes questioned the sexualization of a field where women are still fighting for their work and achievements to receive greater recognition.

That context makes Syrn’s new launch particularly notable. “Send Nudes” was not presented as a response to the Novig controversy, but its arrival so soon afterward inevitably places Sydney’s new images within a conversation that was already underway.

articles.standfirst: The post highlighted the growing popularity of coordinated activewear sets that blend performance and style
articles.summary: The post highlighted the growing popularity of coordinated activewear sets that blend performance and style
articles.body:
L ivvy Dunne recently shared a lighthearted social media post that showcased both her athletic style and playful personality.

The former LSU gymnastics star posted a short video of herself dancing around her kitchen while sipping from a berry-colored tumbler. Dressed in a coordinated black workout set from Vuori, Dunne appeared relaxed as she smiled, swayed to the music and playfully moved around the room.

Her outfit featured Vuori's AllTheFeels Low Rise Shorty and the matching AllTheFeels Support Tank 2.0. The activewear set is designed with the brand's BlissBlend fabric, which offers four-way stretch and moisture-wicking performance for workouts and everyday wear.

From praise for her energetic personality to admiration

The casual clip provided a glimpse into Dunne's off-duty routine away from training, appearances and other professional commitments. The video leaned into a spontaneous, everyday moment, rather than a polished production.

Fans reacted in the comments section, leaving compliments and supportive messages. Responses ranged from praise for her energetic personality to admiration for her athletic look, with many followers filling the post with heart emojis and encouraging remarks.

Dunne completed the outfit with a sleek ponytail, gold hoop earrings and a delicate gold bracelet. Her beauty look remained simple, featuring defined brows, glowing skin and neutral-toned makeup that complemented the relaxed, post-workout vibe of the video.

Matching workout pieces have become a staple

The post also highlighted the growing popularity of coordinated activewear sets that blend performance and style. Designed for movement while maintaining a streamlined look, matching workout pieces have become a staple both inside and outside the gym.

While the video lasted only a few seconds, its appeal came from its simplicity. A quick dance break, a comfortable workout outfit and a carefree attitude were enough to turn an ordinary moment into an engaging social media post.

articles.title: Clint Eastwood's daily habit, at 96 years old, for his longevity: exercise, healthy eating, and a technique Hugh Jackman copies
articles.standfirst: The actor reached that age last May
articles.summary: The actor reached that age last May
articles.body:
C lint Eastwood is a legend of American cinema . Last May, he turned 96 years old , and although he still has four years to go to catch up with some centenarian colleagues like Dick Van Dyke or Mel Brooks, his longevity and good health are already more than commendable .

Throughout his extensive career as an actor and director, Eastwood has shared the set with countless great performers . The list includes names such as: Richard Burton, Tom Hanks, Leonardo DiCaprio, Morgan Freeman or, of course, Sergio Leone, with whom he made the famous Dollar Trilogy .

Many of those actors share traits with Eastwood, but there is one in which the latter stands out above the rest: age . Turning 96 is not easy for everyone, but Clint follows a strict physical care routine that has helped him stay in good shape well beyond nine decades of age.

The secret Eastwood keeps to preserve his longevity: meditation

In addition to a good diet and doing a lot of sports , the Californian has included in his daily habits an exercise that is becoming increasingly common among his fellow professionals and the population in general. It is meditation .

"Shawn Levy described in the biography ‘Clint: The Man and the Movies’ that the actor is a “ lifelong gym and fitness fanatic ” and that he has followed a “ low-fat organic diet ” since turning 50. But in addition, he likes to take care of his physical and mental rest, which is why he has practiced Transcendental Meditation exercises for years. “ He meditated a lot, especially during work . And all of it while portraying the Man with No Name, Dirty Harry, and other bloodthirsty characters,” Levy explains.

A technique that he does for 20 minutes twice a day to reduce the onset of stress . And it’s not something only Eastwood does; other actors such as Hugh Jackman are also keen to practice routines and meditation exercises .

articles.title: Albert Einstein, Theoretical physicist: "Try not to become a man of success. Rather become a man of value"
articles.standfirst: The celebrated scientist transformed our understanding of space, time and energy but also of imagination, knowledge and life.
articles.summary: The celebrated scientist transformed our understanding of space, time and energy but also of imagination, knowledge and life.
articles.body:
Albert Einstein became one of the most influential scientists in history by reshaping how humanity understood the universe.

Born in Germany in 1879, the theoretical physicist developed the theory of relativity, but his path to scientific prominence was not immediate. At 17, Einstein enrolled in a mathematics and physics teaching program at the Swiss Federal Polytechnic School in Zurich , graduating in 1900.

He later became a Swiss citizen and took a position at the Swiss Patent Office in Bern at the heart of Europe , where he continued developing the ideas that would transform modern physics.

And it was the year 1905 became particularly important in Einstein 's career, often called his “miracle year,” as he published four groundbreaking papers on the photoelectric effect, Brownian motion, special relativity and mass-energy equivalence.

Then decade later, Einstein expanded his work with his general theory of relativity, incorporating gravity into his framework and laying foundations for modern theoretical cosmology.

Einstein's ideas extended beyond physics

His scientific work eventually earned him the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics , which recognized his work on theoretical physics and especially his explanation of the photoelectric effect.

But he then had to leave his home Germany behind as the scientist took a staunch stance against Nazi fascism, when Adolf Hitler came to power in 1933 as he opted to remain in the United States – horrified by their policies.

The decision saw him become an American citizen in 1940 and continued his scientific work and public activities until his death in 1955 , leaving behind a legacy that reached far beyond the laboratory but as one of the most famous humans to ever walk the Earth.

And Einstein 's legacy is not limited to equations and scientific theories as his observations about human potential, knowledge and achievement have continued to capture minds decades after his death.

And one of his most frequently cited remarks focuses on the difference between achieving recognition and creating lasting value, offering a simple perspective on how people measure a meaningful life.

“Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value,” Einstein once said as the quote reflects his emphasis on contribution rather than recognition alone.

The sentiment reflects a broader theme in his writings and public comments: the importance of curiosity, imagination and ideas that extend beyond established knowledge.

He also emphasized the power of imagination in driving discovery and progress, arguing that creativity could help people move beyond the limits of established knowledge and existing ideas.

“Imagination is more important than knowledge. For knowledge is limited, whereas imagination embraces the entire world, stimulating progress, giving birth to evolution,” Einstein said in 1929 to George Sylvester.

Einstein died on April 18, 1955 in Princeton, New Jersey after suffering from internal bleeding caused by an abdominal aortic aneurysm despite undergoing surgery for the problem just seven years earlier.

Einstein embraced his death with open arms and rejected further surgery to prolong his life with another deep thought, saying, "I want to go when I want. It is tasteless to prolong life artificially. I have done my share; it is time to go. I will do it elegantly."

articles.title: J.Lo stuns without makeup, details 'empty nest' transition after twins leave for college
articles.standfirst: Jennifer Lopez embraces a new chapter after her twins leave home
articles.summary: Jennifer Lopez embraces a new chapter after her twins leave home
articles.body:
Jennifer Lopez is embracing a major life change with the everyday rituals that have long helped her stay grounded.

The 57-year-old singer, actress and entrepreneur recently appeared makeup-free in a video shared through her JLo Beauty brand, giving fans an unfiltered look at her complexion while opening up about an emotional new chapter in her life.

Lopez is now navigating the reality of becoming an empty nester as her 18-year-old twins, Max and Oskar , prepare to begin college. The children, whom she shares with former husband Marc Anthony, have been at the center of Lopez’s world for nearly two decades, making their departure a particularly meaningful milestone for the devoted mother.

In her beauty video, Lopez explained that she’d been thinking about routines while preparing for her children to leave home.

“I was just about to start my skincare routine, and I was thinking about routines because my kids are going away to college,” said Lopez .

Skincare represents more than maintaining Lopez’s appearance. She described familiar daily habits as something that can provide stability when life feels uncertain. Along with taking care of her skin, she identified exercise as another important part of her routine.

The star also encouraged her followers to continue looking after themselves during difficult or transitional periods.

A new chapter beyond motherhood

Lopez’s reflections on her children leaving home come amid a period of considerable personal change. Her divorce from Ben Affleck was finalized in January 2025, following their high-profile marriage and subsequent split.

She has since spoken about an emotional experience involving her father, David Lopez , that helped her gain a different perspective on her relationships and the difficult period she was experiencing.

While watching the Brazilian film I’m Still Here with her father, Lopez became emotional as she thought about her children, her relationship with her dad and events in her own life.

"I said, 'Dads are so important.' And he just kind of came over to me and grabbed my face and said, 'I love you. I always loved you.' And that kind of changed my life in that moment,” said Lopez .

"(It) healed a part of me that needed to be healed to kind of move on from that part of my life and from those types of relationships in my life. So that movie changed me and helped me grow."

Her commitment to skincare also remains closely connected to her professional identity. Lopez launched JLo Beauty on January 1, 2021, transforming her long-discussed approach to skincare into a commercial brand centered on products designed to support a healthy-looking complexion.

Now, as Max and Oskar step into adulthood, Lopez is facing a different kind of transformation.

articles.standfirst: Rob Lowe had to wait decades to find something that could compete with his worst Oscars memory.
articles.summary: Rob Lowe had to wait decades to find something that could compete with his worst Oscars memory.
articles.body:
In 1989, Lowe joined Snow White for the Oscars’ opening musical number . What was supposed to be a big moment for the ceremony ended up becoming one of the most awkward performances ever seen on the awards show stage.

And while the number lasted only a few minutes, its consequences lasted much longer. For years, the moment kept coming up whenever people talked about the worst Oscars openings.

So when 2022 arrived, Lowe thought that story might finally be left behind.

On March 27, 2022, during the 94th Academy Awards , one of the most unexpected moments in recent Oscars history unfolded: Will Smith slapped Chris Rock onstage after the comedian made a comment about Jada Pinkett Smith .

Understandably, viewers watching the broadcast were trying to process what had just happened. What had been an awards ceremony until that point had completely changed in a matter of seconds, and no one seemed quite sure how to react.

But Lowe experienced the moment very differently. He recently recalled what happened and admitted: “When Will Smith slapped Chris Rock, I was the only person who was happy.”

The reason came down to what immediately went through his mind: “Oh, good. Now that’s the worst moment in the history of the Oscars.”

But Will Smith couldn’t save him from the jokes

The slap became one of the biggest moments in Oscars history, but it didn’t manage to knock Lowe out of that conversation.

The actor said he is still the subject of jokes because of that performance. The latest example even came at the 2026 Emmys, when someone referenced his old controversy again with a comment that , essentially, celebrated the fact that at least this time, it wasn’t Rob.

articles.title: Maimonides, philosopher: "The crime that is committed most repeatedly should be punished more severely"'
articles.standfirst: The doctor and rabbi reflects on the importance of tackling the most common crimes
articles.summary: The doctor and rabbi reflects on the importance of tackling the most common crimes
articles.body:
Democratic society is governed by rights and obligations, and failing to comply with certain laws can lead to imprisonment . This way of punishing offenses and crimes involves the deprivation of liberty and, usually, the length of the sentence imposed varies according to the severity, but for some, such as the philosopher Maimonides , this type of approach is not entirely correct.

The also rabbi and Hispano-Jewish physician once said: “The crime that is committed most repeatedly should be punished more severely” . This idea suggests that sentences should be harsher for those types of offenses and crimes that are seen most often in a court and not those less common in a society.

Harsher punishment for the crimes most repeatedly committed in society

Maimonides' thinking involves accepting that the rarest crimes should be accompanied by lighter punishments , since he considers that they can be corrected more easily. Meanwhile, the fact that some crimes are committed lightly in a society is because their punishments are not strong enough and, therefore, there is no incentive to stop committing them.

Maimonides was known for questioning the school of thought based on ‘an eye for an eye.’ According to the philosopher, criminal law aims to maintain social order , but if an offense carries very lenient penalties, it is because the punishment is not strong enough to prevent society from continuing to take advantage of breaking the laws.

This is why, based on the rabbi's belief, the punishment must be proportional to the number of times that crime has been committed . In fact, it is better understood with the second part of Maimonides' quote, which goes as follows: “Those that occur only as a rare case can be corrected and suppressed by means of lighter penalties.”

articles.title: Niccolo Machiavelli, author and philosopher: "He who wishes to be obeyed must know how to command"
articles.standfirst: Machiavelli's famous words offer a concise view of leadership, authority and the responsibilities of power.
articles.summary: Machiavelli's famous words offer a concise view of leadership, authority and the responsibilities of power.
articles.body:
N iccolo Machiavelli was an Italian Renaissance diplomat , author , philosopher and historian whose life was closely connected to the political instability of his era, sparking his strong words on ruling. Born in Florence in 1469 to a modest but educated family led by his father, who worked as a lawyer, Machiavelli received a humanist education, studying Latin, classical literature, history, and philosophy.

Machiavelli entered public service in the Florentine Republic and spent years working in diplomatic and military affairs, serving as secretary to the second chancery of the Republic of Florence from 1498. Suspected of helping the Medici lose power, Machiavelli lost his government position when the Medici later returned in 1512 , and he was falsely implicated in a conspiracy and was tortured before eventually being released on the order of the Pope . After this, he subsequently withdrew from public life and devoted himself to political writing and study and that experience helped shape the ideas for which Machiavelli became famous. is most well-known work, The Prince , was written in 1513 and examined how rulers could acquire and maintain authority in an unpredictable political world and highlighted a sense of pragmaticism over an idealized descriptions of how leaders should behave. Machiavelli died on June 21, 1517 from an unknown stomach condition that he had battled against for two years. He was aged 58 and was buried at the Church of Santa Croce in Florence .

Niccolo Machiavelli: "He who wishes to be obeyed must know how to command"

Machiavelli remained a controversial figure after his death in 1527 as his name eventually became associated with manipulation and ruthless political tactics, although his writings have continued to generate over his intentions and the meaning. "He who wishes to be obeyed must know how to command," captures Machiavelli' s broader interest in the relationship between authority and effective leadership, as the idea suggests that simply possessing a position of power is not enough. The quote places responsibility on the person exercising authority. A leader must be capable of giving clear direction, making decisions and understanding the people they are attempting to lead. That perspective reflects the theme Machiavelli 's work. Rather than focusing exclusively on how leaders ought to behave, he examined how rulers actually respond when confronted by political pressure, uncertainty and competing interests. And the timeless nature of his words have extended beyond Renaissance politics to be studied by generations of philosophers, academics and political thinkers, whilst his Discourses on Livy has also been associated with the development of modern republican thought.

articles.title: Clint Eastwood, a 96-year-old actor and director: “If you want a guarantee, buy a toaster"
articles.standfirst: Eastwood is best known for starring in Western movies.
articles.summary: Eastwood is best known for starring in Western movies.
articles.body:
Clint Eastwood has spent more than seven decades building a career around characters who rarely have easy answers, and one of his most memorable lines offers a typically blunt take on the uncertainty that comes with life.

The legendary actor and director delivered the line in 1990's The Rookie , using a simple household appliance to make a broader point about the expectations people place on life.

“If you want a guarantee, buy a toaster,” Eastwood says, reducing the complicated search for certainty to a memorable one-liner and it fits as his career has itself been anything but predictable.

He first became widely known through the Western genre before expanding into a wide range of roles and eventually establishing himself as one of Hollywood 's most respected directors. His films have repeatedly explored personal conflicts, difficult decisions and the consequences of choices.

Eastwood first found success in the television series Rawhide before becoming an international star as the Man with No Name in Sergio Leone 's Dollars Trilogy during the 1960s. He later became equally recognizable as Harry Callahan in the Dirty Harry series.

His filmography eventually stretched far beyond Westerns , with roles in Escape from Alcatraz , Heartbreak Ridge , In the Line of Fire and The Bridges of Madison County . His later acting credits included Gran Torino and The Mule and keeping with the unexpected element, Eastwood also developed an acclaimed career behind the camera.

He won the Academy Award for Best Director and Best Picture for Unforgiven in 1992 before achieving the same double with Million Dollar Baby in 2004 and continued directing films without appearing in them, including Mystic River , Letters from Iwo Jima and Juror #2 , demonstrating the breadth of a career that extended well beyond his early Western success.

What Clint Eastwood's famous toaster quote means

The idea behind the quote is straightforward. A toaster can come with a warranty because it is a manufactured product with specific conditions under which it can be repaired or replaced but life offers no comparable guarantee.

People naturally spend much of their lives trying to make the future more predictable. Plans are made, decisions are delayed and opportunities are sometimes postponed because there is an assumption that another chance will come along.

Yet nobody can know exactly what will happen next. That is what gives Eastwood 's line its staying power. Rather than presenting uncertainty as something that can be eliminated, the quote treats it as an unavoidable part of being alive.

After decades of making films about characters confronting difficult choices, Eastwood 's observation remains a concise reminder that certainty is something we can demand from a household appliance, but not from life itself.

articles.title: Sylvester Stallone reveals at 80 what lay behind his famous physique in "Rocky III": "It was an obsession"
articles.standfirst: For decades, his body was one of the most recognizable images in action cinema. Now, the actor revealed how far he went to maintain that appearance and admitted that he ended up paying "a terrible price."
articles.summary: For decades, his body was one of the most recognizable images in action cinema. Now, the actor revealed how far he went to maintain that appearance and admitted that he ended up paying "a terrible price."
articles.body:
Sylvester Stallone turned his physique into an inseparable part of characters like Rocky Balboa and John Rambo. The muscles and demanding workouts ended up becoming part of an image that defined a good part of his career in Hollywood.

But behind that body there was a much more extreme reality. At 80, Stallone has revealed that this quest to stay increasingly defined ended up turning into an obsession that reached one of its most extreme points during the filming of Rocky III .

Stallone admits he became bulimic

The actor explained in an interview with The New York Times that he initially began to see his body as a kind of "armor". While the first Rocky had the appearance of a relatively normal man, as the films went on he wanted to increasingly transform his appearance.

Stallone was looking for a different physique from Arnold Schwarzenegger's. He didn't want to simply be bigger, but to resemble "a jaguar, a cat": a fierce, flexible, and athletic body . However, that pursuit ended up crossing a line.

'" Then it became an obsession . Very serious," he admitted. And right afterward he made a confession that, he said, he had never shared publicly: " It got to the point where I became bulimic ".'

One of the most extreme moments came with Rocky III , released in 1982. Stallone said that during that period he reached approximately 2.6% body fat .

The actor explained that he reached a point where he did not want to keep food inside his body because he was obsessed with preserving that definition. He himself described that stage as a kind of "obsessive body cult."

Stallone also admits that he used steroids

The demands didn’t end with training and diet. Stallone also admitted that he resorted to steroids to achieve and maintain that physique.

'When the interviewer asked him directly if he was saying that he took steroids, his response was forceful: "Oh my God, you have to do it". '

Stallone explained that he used them in six-week cycles and then rested for another six. According to his account, maintaining that level of physical condition for months was not something that could be achieved simply with diet and training.

"No one does it without additives and drugs, period", he stated. And he was even more direct when talking about the possibility of achieving that body without those substances: "You don't get to look like that naturally".

"Cop Land," the movie that changed his relationship with his body

The obsession began to lose strength years later. Stallone pointed to Cop Land , a film released in 1997, as a turning point in his relationship with his image.

To portray Sheriff Freddy Heflin , he had to move away precisely from the physique he had built over the years. His character was overweight, partially deaf, and, in Stallone’s own words, was meant to be "the weakest guy in the room".

That was liberating. For the first time, he didn’t have to maintain on camera the physical appearance that had become one of his hallmarks.

Decades later, Stallone sums up that stage of his life with one phrase: "I have abused my body".

'Nine back operations and "a terrible price"'

The actor also detailed the enormous physical wear and tear accumulated over the course of his career. He said he has undergone nine back surgeries, two shoulder surgeries, and three cervical fusions.

He even joked that practically his whole body is held together with wire. Even so, he continues trying to stay in shape, although his relationship with that concept of the body as "armor" has changed completely.

Stallone also acknowledged that he needs numerous medications to keep going. Reflecting on the consequences of decades of pushing his physique to the limit, he summed up his situation bluntly: "It has come at a terrible price".

And if he could go back to the beginning of his career, there is one thing he would do differently. Stallone says he would leave the dangerous scenes in the hands of the specialists and would not insist on personally performing his own stunts.

articles.title: Taylor Swift premiers Patient Zero at the VMAs: She enjoyed it alongside Dakota Johnson
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift turned the 2026 VMAs into another unforgettable moment, premiering her highly anticipated “Patient Zero” music video during the ceremony.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift turned the 2026 VMAs into another unforgettable moment, premiering her highly anticipated “Patient Zero” music video during the ceremony.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift didn’t need to perform at the 2026 VMAs to steal the spotlight. The pop superstar premiered the music video for “Patient Zero” during the ceremony, celebrating the release alongside Dakota Johnson , who star in the highly anticipated project. Swift also made history by receiving the inaugural Artist Director award , becoming the most awarded artist in Video Music Awards history .

The song is part of “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore” , the extended edition of her latest album, which arrived this Friday, September 25 , featuring four additional tracks. Swift surprised fans by announcing the project earlier this week.

Everything we know about the video

The music video was directed by Taylor Swift herself, while cinematography was handled by Emmanuel Lubezki , the three-time Oscar winner for “Gravity,” “Birdman,” and “The Revenant.”

The project features two major Hollywood stars as its protagonists: Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell .

On Thursday, during her appearance on CBS Mornings , Swift shared a 13-second teaser, a number that holds special meaning within her universe of clues and references. She later posted the preview on social media with only two words:

The footage shows Swift turning on a faucet inside a dark bathroom, a scene where she and Johnson face each other at a sink as if they were reflections of one another, both women jumping into a pool, a cemetery featuring a coffin and a black rose, Farrell stepping out of a car, and all three protagonists dressed entirely in black.

The teaser also shows a close-up of Swift crying, where fans quickly noticed her engagement ring. Everything is accompanied by a soundtrack featuring Irish-inspired strings and ends with what appears to be the title of a movie.

So far, Swift has not revealed the plot or the characters. As often happens with her projects, fans have spent days trying to decode every image and connect the clues to previous references. The answer will arrive during the ceremony.

When and where to watch the premiere

The 2026 VMAs will begin at 7:30 PM ET (4:30 PM PT) and will air on CBS , with a simultaneous broadcast on MTV and streaming through Paramount+ Premium .

CBS and MTV confirmed that the “Patient Zero” music video will have its world premiere during the ceremony, although the exact moment has not yet been revealed. Everything suggests it could coincide with the presentation of the Artist Director award.

Until now, Taylor Swift and Beyoncé shared the record for the most awards in VMAs history, with 30 trophies each .

With the new Artist Director honor , Swift will reach 31 awards and become the most decorated artist in the history of the event.

She also enters the ceremony with 11 competitive nominations, including Video of the Year for “The Fate of Ophelia” and Best Direction for “Opalite.” According to record analyses, she could finish the night with up to 42 total awards.

She also has the chance to become the first artist to win Artist of the Year three times.

Anyone hoping to watch the premiere of “Patient Zero” as soon as possible will need to tune in from the beginning of the ceremony. The video will later be available on YouTube, but its world premiere will take place exclusively during the VMAs.

articles.title: Robert De Niro, actor and producer: "Time goes on. So whatever you're going to do, do it. Do it now. Don't wait"
articles.standfirst: De Niro’s career spans more than six decades and covers some of the most recognizable films in Hollywood
articles.summary: De Niro’s career spans more than six decades and covers some of the most recognizable films in Hollywood
articles.body:
Robert De Niro has spent more than six decades building one of the most celebrated acting careers in American cinema , from Mean Streets and Taxi Driver to Goodfellas , Heat and Joker . Born August 17, 1943 , in New York City , De Niro discovered acting as a child and left high school at 16 to pursue it professionally, as he studied with Stella Adler and Lee Strasberg before landing early film roles in Greetings , Bloody Mama and Hi, Mom!

His breakthrough came in 1973. De Niro starred in Bang the Drum Slowly and began his landmark collaboration with Martin Scorsese in Mean Streets. A year later, Francis Ford Coppola cast him as the young Vito Corleone in The Godfather Part II. His role and performance saw De Niro win his first Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor and marked one of the rare cases that many people consider the sequel of a movie to have eclipsed its predecessor. He then won his second Oscar in 1981 for Raging Bull, portraying boxer Jake LaMotta. The performance established a pattern that would define his career: intense preparation, physical transformation and an ability to tackle demanding roles. De Niro went on to earn Oscar nominations for Taxi Driver, The Deer Hunter, Awakenings, Cape Fear, Silver Linings Playbook and Killers of the Flower Moon. He also earned a Best Picture nomination as a producer of The Irishman. De Niro became closely associated with hard-edged dramas, appearing in classics such as The King of Comedy, Once Upon a Time in America, The Untouchables, Goodfellas, Heat, Casino and Jackie Brown. He also showed a different side of his range through comedies including Midnight Run, Analyze This, Wag the Dog, The Intern and the Meet the Parents series. articles.title: Sydney Sweeney strips down for racy new lingerie shoot—with a hidden message for Scooter Braun
articles.standfirst: Sweeney’s latest sultry shoot features a tiny detail that has fans talking about Braun
articles.summary: Sweeney’s latest sultry shoot features a tiny detail that has fans talking about Braun
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney has once again found a way to blend glamour with a personal touch. The 29-year-old actress recently appeared in a new campaign for her lingerie label, SYRN, wearing a delicate necklace bearing the initials “SB,” a detail fans have interpreted as a nod to her boyfriend, Scooter Braun.

In the latest images, Sweeney modelled SYRN’s Smooth Cup Demi in the brand’s “Babe” shade, pairing the pale lingerie with the gold necklace.

Her styling and playful expression kept the tone of the pictures light, while the initials around her neck added a more intimate detail. Neither Sweeney nor SYRN has officially confirmed what the charms represent, but “SB” naturally echoes Braun’s initials.

The necklace isn’t entirely new to Sweeney’s recent fashion appearances. Similar jewelry has been spotted in earlier SYRN promotional material, giving fans another reason to connect the accessory with her increasingly public relationship.

Sweeney and Braun have made their romance more public

Sweeney and Braun were first linked in 2025 after reportedly meeting during the wedding celebrations for Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez in Venice.

Their relationship gradually attracted more attention, and by April 2026, the pair had effectively gone public on social media. Since then, they’ve been photographed together at events, festivals and while traveling.

Their connection has also become more visible in recent months. They were seen together in Venice during the 2026 film festival, where they attended events and were photographed holding hands and kissing during sightseeing outings.

People has also reported that their relationship has become serious, with Sweeney spending time with Braun’s children.

The actress has previously spoken about the difficulty of dating while living under intense public scrutiny. She told Cosmopolitan that ordinary romantic experiences can become complicated when millions of people have opinions about her private life, adding that she still wants the opportunity to experience love while navigating that attention.

“I understand that I’m a public person, but I’m still in my 20s. I’m still figuring out love, and it’s hard to do that with millions of people who have their own opinions of what that looks like,” said Sweeney .

“At the same time, for all of my 20s, I put my head down and focused on work—and now I want to experience things. But it’s hard deciding that I want to experience love in the public eye. I’m just navigating it all.”

Braun , meanwhile, has spoken warmly about Sweeney in public. In May, he described her as kind, generous, intelligent, genuine and down to earth during a podcast appearance.

He has also publicly celebrated her on special occasions, offering affectionate comments about their relationship.

The couple’s romance has faced outside attention, including reports that Sweeney was encouraged to reconsider the relationship. Representatives for Ari Emanuel denied claims that he advised her to end things with Braun . The reports nevertheless added to the scrutiny given the pair have increasingly chosen to show their relationship in public.

articles.title: Wladimir Klitschko seeks temporary guardianship over late Hayden Panettiere’s estate for daughter Kaya
articles.standfirst: Klitschko’s court filing raises fresh concerns about Panettiere’s belongings and the future of her estate
articles.summary: Klitschko’s court filing raises fresh concerns about Panettiere’s belongings and the future of her estate
articles.body:
Wladimir Klitschko has made an urgent legal move to protect the inheritance of his and late actress Hayden Panettiere’s daughter, Kaya , following the actress’s death in August.

The former heavyweight boxing champion has petitioned a Los Angeles court to appoint him temporary guardian of 11-year-old Kaya’s estate, according to court documents reported by Page Six and TMZ.

The filing says the appointment would allow Klitschko to receive, manage and safeguard assets that his daughter is entitled to inherit from her mother.

Kaya is a U.S. citizen but currently lives abroad with her father. Because she’s Panettiere’s only surviving child, Klitschko’s petition states that Kaya is entitled to the assets that form part of her mother’s California probate estate.

Panettiere’s estate has reportedly been valued at around $6 million, although its final value and distribution will be determined through the probate process.

Panettiere died on August 16 at the age of 36 while staying at a residence in Greenville, South Carolina. The Greenville County Coroner determined that her death was accidental and resulted from the toxic effects of multiple substances, including fentanyl.

Klitschko’s filing says there’s currently no personal representative in place to protect Panettiere’s estate. He argues that the situation requires immediate action because some of the actress’s belongings could potentially be lost, damaged or improperly taken before an administrator is formally appointed.

Klitschko raises concerns about missing belongings

The petition also details security concerns involving Panettiere’s California property. According to the documents, Panettiere and Klitschko had previously hired a security service after an unidentified person allegedly gained unauthorized access to her home.

Following her death, the security company reportedly changed the locks. Storage units containing designer clothing and accessories worn by Panettiere at public appearances were also moved as a precaution, according to the filing.

Klitschko further claims that some of Panettiere’s personal possessions, including jewelry, have disappeared or remain unaccounted for. Other belongings are reportedly in the custody of law enforcement in connection with the investigation into her death.

The former boxer also alleges that federal agents entered Panettiere’s residence and removed property belonging to her estate. The petition says having temporary guardianship would give him the legal authority to initiate probate proceedings and nominate a proposed administrator who could formally oversee the estate.

Panettiere and Klitschko began their relationship in 2009 and welcomed Kaya in December 2014. Their relationship continued on and off for several years before ending in 2018.

That same year, Panettiere transferred custody of Kaya to Klitschko while she was dealing with postpartum depression and addiction. Klitschko subsequently raised their daughter in Ukraine.

Despite living apart, Panettiere continued to speak about her relationship with Kaya . In a 2026 podcast appearance, she described their bond as intense and incredible and rejected suggestions that she had abandoned her daughter.

Following Panettiere’s death, Klitschko publicly remembered her as an important part of his life and the mother of Kaya . He said he would continue speaking about her with respect so their daughter could remember her mother.

articles.title: Karol G ‘excites’ Drake by grinding on him at concert: ‘Ay, qué rico!’
articles.standfirst: The Colombian singer had Drake as a special guest.
articles.summary: The Colombian singer had Drake as a special guest.
articles.body:
K arol G arrived in Houston, Texas, this Sunday, September 27, 2026, as part of her “Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour” world tour , but her performance at Reliant Stadium had a surprise in store for the final minutes. Drake appeared as a special guest and joined the singer onstage to perform alongside her .

The performance kicked off with “Ahí,” the collaboration they released in August 2026 and, until that Sunday, had never performed together live.

Drake then continued with “One Dance,” but while performing the song, Karol G walked over and started dancing very close to him. The crowd immediately reacted.

Laughing, Drake grabbed the microphone and blurted out a spontaneous “Ay, qué rico!” , sending another wave of screams through the stadium. The rapper continued with the song, although he ended up visibly overheated after the interaction with Karol G.

Their closeness also sparked speculation outside the stadium. Some people began wondering whether there could be something more between them or if they simply have chemistry that works onstage . For now, there is nothing confirming a relationship between the two, and both continue to focus on their respective careers.

Karol G continues her tour

After Houston, Karol G has upcoming shows scheduled in Miami, Tampa and Arlington. The tour will also stop in Monterrey, where she will perform at Estadio BBVA on November 6, 7 and 8, and in Mexico City, with concerts at Estadio GNP Seguros on November 13, 14 and 15.

articles.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's daughter, Zahara, legally drops her father's surname
articles.standfirst: Zahara Jolie officially drops ‘Pitt’ from her name after years of family turmoil
articles.summary: Zahara Jolie officially drops ‘Pitt’ from her name after years of family turmoil
articles.body:
Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt’s daughter Zahara has officially removed her father’s surname from her legal name, marking another development involving the former Hollywood couple’s children.

A Los Angeles judge approved Zahara’s petition on Sept. 28, changing her name from Zahara Marley Jolie-Pitt to Zahara Marley Jolie .

Court records show there were no objections to the request, and the decree was signed and filed following a hearing at the Stanley Mosk Courthouse.

The 21-year-old had already been using “ Zahara Marley Jolie ” publicly before the court made the change permanent. At her May graduation from Spelman College in Atlanta, she was introduced by that name while receiving her diploma. She had also used the name during her Alpha Kappa Alpha sorority induction ceremony in November 2023.

Zahara filed her petition earlier this year, and legal notices concerning the proposed change were subsequently published in the Los Angeles Daily Journal.

The publication was part of California’s legal process for name-change petitions, giving others an opportunity to object before the hearing.

Her attorney, Peter Kenneth Levine , appeared remotely during Monday’s proceeding, while Judge Virginia Keeny presided over the hearing.

Zahara’s decision follows similar changes

Zahara’s legal name change comes as several of Jolie and Pitt’s six children have moved away from using their father’s surname.

Their eldest son, Maddox , 25, officially changed his name from Maddox Chivan Jolie-Pitt to Maddox Chivan Jolie earlier in September.

Shiloh , 20, made a similar move in 2024 after filing a petition to remove “Pitt” from her name shortly after turning 18.

Vivienne , 18, has also petitioned to change her legal name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie. Her request remains pending, with a court hearing scheduled for November.

Meanwhile, Knox has reportedly used Jolie rather than Jolie-Pitt on his high school diploma. Pax , 22, hasn’t publicly announced a comparable legal name change.

The developments come against the backdrop of Jolie and Pitt’s prolonged separation and divorce. Jolie filed for divorce in September 2016 after two years of marriage. The former couple were declared legally single in 2019, but their remaining divorce disputes continued for several more years before they reached a settlement in December 2024.

The reasons for Zahara’s decision haven’t been publicly explained in detail in the court documents. However, people close to both Jolie and Pitt have offered sharply different perspectives on the family’s relationship.

A source close to Pitt characterized the name changes as part of what they described as parental alienation.

“This is the latest installment in what complete and total alienation looks like with an extra topping of trying to deflect attention from their ex’s success. Anyone who has actually been a part of this for the last ten years would know that there’s only one side that talks about and has tried to weaponize the kids,” the source stated.

A source close to Jolie rejected that interpretation and said the hearing had been scheduled months in advance as part of the normal legal process.

articles.title: Jennifer Lopez stopped to tell photographers to “stop acting crazy” after they followed her
articles.standfirst: The superstar has maintained close relationships with major designers for years
articles.summary: The superstar has maintained close relationships with major designers for years
articles.body:
J ennifer Lopez knows how to make an entrance in a fashion capital. But as photographers followed her through Paris , the superstar appeared to have one request: give her some space.

Lopez stopped to address photographers who were pursuing her for pictures, telling them to "stop acting crazy" as she made her way through the French capital. The moment came as Lopez arrived in France's capital for Paris Fashion Week, following several days in Milan for the Italian leg of Fashion Month.

Her Paris arrival was stylish as ever

The 57-year-old star stepped out in a silky white slip dress covered in swirling floral lace, a look seemingly from Dior. The dress featured an easy, relaxed silhouette that contrasted with some of the more overtly glamorous ensembles she has worn throughout Fashion Month.

She paired the white dress with black leather loafers and long white socks, adding a preppy edge to the romantic look. A quilted black Lady Dior bag provided another classic touch. Lopez accessorized with layers of gold, diamond and pearl jewelry, while oversized black aviator sunglasses added a signature touch.

Her hair was pulled into a deliberately undone low bun, completing the Paris-ready ensemble. Just days earlier, Lopez was in Milan , where major fashion houses including Prada, Gucci, Fendi and Bottega Veneta presented their Spring 2027 collections.

Lopez embraced the glamour associated with Dolce & Gabbana

For one Milan outing, she opted for a comparatively classic combination of a crisp white button-down shirt and high-waisted, wide-leg blue jeans. Naturally, Lopez added her own glamorous spin. She finished the outfit with pointy PVC heels, chunky maroon sunglasses and Dolce & Gabbana's My Sicily handbag in black calfskin.

A watch, gold pinky ring and voluminous waves completed the look. Her Milan appearances came amid a particularly fashion-heavy stretch for Lopez . She has maintained close relationships with major designers for years, making her a familiar presence during Fashion Month.

At Vogue World 2026 in Milan, Lopez embraced the glamour associated with Dolce & Gabbana , appearing in a dramatic black tulle gown embellished with sequins, sheer opera gloves and turquoise-toned diamond jewelry. She also made an unexpected appearance on the Vogue World runway after being invited onto the stage by Italian tennis star Lorenzo Musetti.

Now, the fashion spotlight has shifted to Paris. Paris Fashion Week runs through Oct. 6, giving Lopez plenty of opportunities to showcase more of her signature style. For Lopez, fashion has long been an important part of her public persona. Whether she's attending a runway show or simply walking through a city, her outfits frequently blend polished glamour with elements that feel distinctly her own.

articles.title: Sylvester Stallone, 80, reveals why he did not go to his mother's funeral: “Some people should not have children”
articles.standfirst: At 80 years old, the star of Rocky decided to share unknown details of his childhood, his complicated relationship with his parents, the death of his son Sage, and the decisions that shaped his life in and out of Hollywood.

articles.body:
S ylvester Stallone decided to look back and tell some of the most difficult chapters of his life. At 80 years old and with the publication of The Steps, his new memoir, the Rocky star speaks of a complicated childhood, the wounds he carried for decades, and a family relationship that was far from the image he would later project in Hollywood.

One of the most striking revelations has to do with his mother, Jackie Stallone . The actor said he was playing golf when he received the news of her death in 2020 and acknowledged that he did not attend her funeral . Behind that decision was a relationship marked for decades by an enormous emotional distance.

The difficult relationship Sylvester Stallone had with his mother

Stallone has spoken bluntly about the lack of affection he felt during his childhood. Remembering Jackie, a woman also known for her eccentric personality and her work related to astrology, he stated that he never received from her the affection he expected from a mother.

“I was playing golf when someone called me and said to me, ‘Your mother has died’”

Reflecting on his past, he said: “She never hugged me.” Stallone grew up with the feeling that his mother simply was not prepared to take on that role, while his relationship with his father, Frank Stallone Sr ., was also marked by distance and difficult episodes.

That childhood, as he now explains, ended up influencing the way he faced much of his adult life. For years he built a personality based on enduring, competing, and proving that he could withstand anything, a kind of armor that he also transferred to characters such as Rocky Balboa .

Success finally came after years of hardship and rejection in New York. Rocky, written by and starring Stallone, transformed his career and made him one of the most recognizable figures in cinema, but it did not necessarily resolve the conflicts he had been carrying long before achieving fame.

The death of his son Sage, another wound that Stallone carries

Decades later, Stallone had to face a completely different loss. His eldest son, Sage Stallone, died in 2012 at the age of 36 from heart disease. The actor has acknowledged that that death continues to be one of the most painful episodes of his life.

The loss also forced him to look at his own experience as a father. Stallone admits that for much of his career he was focused almost exclusively on making his way and staying in Hollywood, something he began to view from a different perspective over the years.

His story will make it to the big screen with I Play Rocky

Stallone's memoir is also arriving at a particularly symbolic moment in his career. Fifty years after the release of Rocky , his story behind that film will be brought to the big screen in I Play Rocky , the biopic directed by Peter Farrelly that will arrive in theaters on November 6, 2026.

The film stars Anthony Ippolito , who plays a young Stallone during the years when he was trying to make his way in Hollywood and refused to part with the Rocky script unless the producers agreed to let him play Rocky Balboa himself. Stallone was not directly involved in the production and acknowledged that he initially had mixed feelings about the idea of his life making it to the big screen while he was still able to tell it.

“I’m not dead yet” , Stallone joked when speaking about the project in an interview with CBS Sunday Morning. However, his reaction changed after seeing Ippolito’s work and noticing the actor’s resemblance to his younger self. The film already had its premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival before its commercial release

Stallone continues working and starring in Tulsa King , but he says that his relationship with time has changed: after decades trying to prove that he could withstand any blow , he now seems more willing to talk about those he never managed to leave completely behind.
